dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the anterior-most visible section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity median pixel value consistent with a mature white skin tone.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, sparse distribution of localized grey-pixel clusters primarily situated on the lower third of the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary white canvas and the localized grey mottling.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, linear rake marks on the upper lateral surfaces and a small dark point disruption near the posterior apex.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent longitudinal linear depression is centered along the dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of fine, parallel linear rake marks on the dorsal surface.
